evidence.decision: Locates consequential simplicity/agency, delight/familiarity and data/responsibility tradeoffs and compares plausible alternatives instead of scoring eight abstract ideals.
evidence.artifact: Requires the chosen flow, copy, specification or scoped implementation; a review must connect a supplied harmful decision to its replacement.
evidence.transformation: Journal onboarding changes from mandatory tutorial/profile collection to immediate writing, skippable help and optional post-save personalization.
evidence.verification: Newcomer/returning walkthroughs test unnecessary gates, reversibility and equivalent-command consistency, without claiming measured emotion or usability.
evidence.applicability: Keeps framework/product scope and treats the decision record as application advice; uncertain research remains an explicit assumption.
evidence.handoffs: Hands off only concrete layout conflicts, unnecessary data collection or an actual platform adaptation to their owning procedures.
evidence.distinctiveness: Explicitly resolves competing principles through task consequences; it cannot be replaced by a generic visual-quality checklist.
